create_optitrack_client: create an OptiTrack client to connect to a motion capture server via UDP and receive streaming pose data
connect_optitrack: connect the OptiTrack client to a streaming server and start background sensor polling thread
read_optitrack_sensors: read streaming sensor data from OptiTrack including timestamp, id, position, and quaternion
reset_optitrack_connection: reset the OptiTrack connection by closing and reconnecting to the streaming server
run_optitrack_cli: run the OptiTrack CLI module with argparse arguments for server, client, port, packet size, and verbose mode
